customers_say: Customers find the water purification unit to be of good quality, with quick and perfect installation, and appreciate its elegant design and functionality for daily home use. The water taste receives positive feedback, with customers noting they can control it according to their water source. The reliability and value for money receive mixed reviews - while some say it works perfectly and is good for its price, others report it stops working properly and consider it a waste of money. The service experience is also mixed, with some praising the customer support while others find it terrible.

reviews.author: Amrendra
reviews.title: Highly recommended
reviews.body: Excellent water purifier – looks premium and works great! I am very happy with this Aquaguard water purifier. The design looks very stylish and premium, and the installation was also smooth. The water quality and taste are good, and the smart display is really useful to keep track of the purifier. The build quality feels good and it looks beautiful on the kitchen wall. Overall, a great product for daily use and definitely worth considering if you are looking for a reliable water purifier. Highly recommended! 💧✨

reviews.title: ### Extremely Disappointing After-Sales Service from Aquaguard###
reviews.body: ### Extremely Disappointing After-Sales Service from Aquaguard The product worked well for the first four months. However, during the fifth month, the TDS level started increasing, and by the end of the fifth month, it had crossed 120. This is when I raised my first service complaint. A technician visited a few days later, carried out some checks, and assured me that the issue would resolve and the purifier would work fine.
